about: Eligibility screening rules for the parcel map. Every threshold or category below carries its source and the date it was checked. A value of null means our sources do not supply it: the test then returns 'unknown'. This is a screen, not a legal determination. Edit this file to add or correct rules; the map reads it at load time.

scag_codes.title: SCAG Zoning_poly_OR layer description: 2024 SCAG Land Use Code table

hcd_sb9.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheet: Duplexes and Lot Splits (SB 9), April 2026

hcd_facts.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheets, combined (April 2026)

fema_sfha.title: FEMA flood zones via OC Floodplains layer; SFHA_TF = 'T' marks a Special Flood Hazard Area

other_residential.label: Other residential (mobile home, mixed residential, rural, general residential)

unknown_zone_codes.7777: Specific Plan: the specific plan document sets what is allowed. Not evaluated.
unknown_zone_codes.null: No SCAG zoning code on this parcel.

tests.label: Zoned to allow single-family or multifamily residential use
Existing or proposed dwelling on the lot
tests.note: Year built is a proxy for an existing building. A proposed dwelling also qualifies, so a missing year built is 'unknown', not 'fail'.

tests.label: Lot is in a single-family residential zone
Not in a Special Flood Hazard Area (exceptions exist)
tests.cite: SB 9 fact sheet p. 3: excluded hazard lands per Gov. Code § 65913.4(a)(6)(B)-(K), with exceptions
tests.note: Sits in a mapped flood hazard area: the excluded-lands list has exceptions, so this needs human review rather than an automatic 'no'.

tests.label: Not in a Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone (exceptions exist)
tests.cite: SB 9 fact sheet p. 3: excluded hazard lands per Gov. Code § 65913.4(a)(6)(B)-(K); HCD letter to Laguna Beach (Sept 19, 2024) on misapplied fire/fault exclusions

tests.label: Big enough to split into two lots of at least 1,200 sq ft (lot split only)
tests.cite: SB 9 fact sheet p. 1 (two 1,200 sq ft lots). 2,400 sq ft is our arithmetic (2 × 1,200), not a stated threshold; the statute also has a proportion rule we did not encode.

tests.label: Within an urbanized area or urban cluster
tests.reason: We have no urbanized-area layer loaded.

tests.label: No tenant in the last 3 years; no rent-restricted or rent-controlled housing demolished
tests.reason: Tenancy and rent-restriction history are not in public parcel data.

tests.label: Not a historic resource or contributing structure in a historic district
No Ellis Act withdrawal in the last 15 years

tests.label: Zoned for multifamily residential use
tests.cite: Starter Home Revitalization Act fact sheet p. 67; HCD letter to Hayward (Jan 28, 2025): applies to any district allowing multifamily, incl. mixed-use

tests.label: Lot under five acres
In an incorporated city (or a large urban county)
tests.note: Unincorporated land may still qualify under the 'large urban county' clause; we do not know the definition, so it returns unknown.

tests.label: Not in a fire hazard zone
tests.cite: SHRA fact sheet p. 67: fire hazard zones are ineligible (exact classes not stated in the fact sheet)

tests.label: Flood hazard area rule
tests.cite: SHRA fact sheet p. 67 lists farmland, wetlands and fire zones; it does not say how flood zones are treated

tests.label: No displacement of rent-controlled or tenant-occupied housing
tests.reason: Tenancy is not in public parcel data.

tests.label: Not farmland or wetlands
tests.reason: No farmland or wetlands layer loaded.

tests.cite: Not in the fact sheet; read Gov. Code § 66499.41
